workItem: Honor the existing profile mfa_required_account policy during normal website login so optional enrolled factors do not force a global AAL2 challenge, while preserving native factors and server-enforced AAL2 for privileged Owner/Admin actions.
workItemDE: LF-02: Account-MFA-Policy beim normalen Google-Login respektieren und globalen AAL2-Zwang für nicht verpflichtete Konten entfernen
projectStage: cross-cutting presentation/auth composition; no productive PVC
priorityReason: The productive Google login still stalls behind optional native-MFA factor discovery/challenge even though the live account policy marks MFA as not required for the normal application login.
scopeBoundary: No email-address or hard-coded user-ID authentication bypass is introduced.
profiles.mfa_required_account is resolved for the verified Supabase user ID together with onboarding_required in one profile read.
A verified optional native MFA factor remains enrolled and available; this change does not delete or mutate auth.mfa_factors.
Accounts with mfa_required_account=true still enter the native AAL2 login gate and fail closed when no usable AAL2 factor exists.
Privileged Owner/Admin server actions continue to enforce requireVerifiedAal2() and applicable purpose-bound step-up independently of the browser login path.
The existing /api/stripe/user-subscription endpoint remains the server-authoritative subscription projection.
No Supabase data/schema mutation, Stripe mutation, Render mutation, deploy, merge, or Human/CODEOWNER authority is performed.

evidence.liveAccountPolicy: The reported Enterprise owner account has onboarding_required=false and mfa_required_account=false while retaining one verified native TOTP factor.
evidence.rootCause: Current SessionComposition challenges every session whose Supabase nextLevel is aal2 solely because a factor is enrolled, before consulting account login-MFA policy. listFactors/challenge is bounded by a 10-second UI timeout and matches the observed delay.
evidence.securityBoundary: Accepted IAM contracts retain server-side AAL2 enforcement for privileged Owner/Admin actions; the browser LoginStepUpGate is orchestration, not the authorization boundary.
evidence.openWriterOverlap: Fresh correlation on main@93893ab46cc0753dc4e86cd7d6120d321bc48651 found no open PR writer overlap for the auth-policy scope; intervening main advancement was SEO-owned.

acceptanceCriteria: Normal Google login reads onboarding_required and mfa_required_account by verified user ID before native factor choreography.
For mfa_required_account=false and onboarding_required=false, the session proceeds directly to authoritative subscription readback without LoginStepUpGate or factor-list/challenge delay.
The optional native TOTP factor remains enrolled and unchanged.
For mfa_required_account=true, aal1->aal2 still renders LoginStepUpGate and missing usable AAL2 evidence fails closed.
Privileged server actions remain protected by requireVerifiedAal2() and applicable step-up controls.
The Enterprise subscription is still projected only after canonical authenticated server readback; no provisional Free state returns.
Focused auth/security/lifecycle tests and required PR gates pass.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession, or abandonment; automation has no merge authority.
